Title: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act"
Summary: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from knowingly providing material support or resources to designated foreign terrorist organizations; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the not-for-profit corporation law, in relation to enacting the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from knowingly providing material support or resources to designated foreign terrorist organizations
